common: A background illustration for a grown-up's picture diary app. The user will draw themselves on top of it with a crayon brush, so: NO people, NO animals, NO faces, NO text, NO letters, NO numbers, NO signature, NO frame or border. Keep colors light and soft (lower saturation) and leave an open, simple area in the lower middle where a person could be drawn. Keep all important elements inside the central 4:3 area; the far left and right edges will be cropped. Fill the whole canvas edge to edge.

style.original: Style: match the attached reference exactly — a child's wax crayon drawing on white paper, visible crayon strokes and paper grain, simple rounded shapes, warm cheerful colors, slightly wobbly lines. Use the reference only for drawing style; do not copy its boy, food or table.
style.pastel: Style: soft pastel wax crayon on cream drawing paper, like a gentle picture book. Light layered strokes, lots of visible paper texture, calm muted colors, slightly wobbly hand-drawn outlines.
style.kid: Style: bold wax crayon drawn by a 7-year-old on rough white paper. Thick uneven outlines, quick back-and-forth coloring that leaves white gaps, naive perspective, bright primary colors but not too dense.
